title: Rethinking Full-Weight LoRA with Domain and Task Adapter Scaling for Question Answering over Portuguese Well Drilling Reports
abstract: arXiv:2611.26833v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to specialized domains remains challenging, particularly for technical documents such as Portuguese well drilling reports, where annotated data are scarce and domain adaptation may compromise instruction-following capabilities. Although Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient adaptation, its scaling after training remains insufficiently explored. This study investigates the impact of LoRA adapter scaling on question answering over Portuguese drilling reports using Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B. Domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT) is performed either directly on instruction-tuned models or on their base counterparts, with subsequent adapter transfer, while task-specific adapters are trained on WellQuest, an open-source question-answering dataset derived from Portuguese drilling reports. translated_title: 重新思考结合领域与任务适配器缩放的全权重LoRA：面向葡萄牙语钻井报告的问答任务
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）适配至专业领域仍然具有挑战性，特别是针对葡萄牙语钻井报告这类技术文档，其标注数据稀缺，且领域适配可能损害模型原有的指令遵循能力。尽管低秩适应（LoRA）被广泛用于参数高效的适配，但其在训练后的缩放策略仍未得到充分探索。本研究使用Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B，探究了LoRA适配器缩放对葡萄牙语钻井报告问答任务的影响。领域自适应预训练（DAPT）既可直接在指令微调模型上进行，也可在其基础模型上进行后再进行适配器迁移；而任务特定适配器则在WellQuest上训练，这是一个源自葡萄牙语钻井报告的开源问答数据集。此外，这两种适配器还可通过互补权重进行组合。缩放因子的范围从……
tldr: 该研究提出在训练后对领域适配与任务特定的LoRA适配器进行缩放、并可用互补权重将二者组合，从而在不损害指令遵循能力的前提下提升大语言模型对葡萄牙语钻井报告问答任务的性能。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that post-training scaling of domain- and task-specific LoRA adapters, which can be combined with complementary weights, improves LLM question answering over Portuguese well drilling reports while preserving instruction-following capability.
